items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Saturday, 23 May 2026 at 10:00pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

High pressure covers the area and much of Europe, while low pressure covers the mid-Atlantic.


##Wind##

South or Southwest 3 or 4, occasionally 5 in the south of the area this evening and overnight, but falling Variable 3 or less in the southeast. Becoming Variable 2 to 4 in all waters tomorrow evening.


##State of Sea##

Slight, occasionally moderate in the south this evening and overnight, falling smooth or slight later.


##Weather##

Mainly fair, but with a risk of mist patches.


##Visibility##

Moderate or good, occasionally poor in any mist.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Variable 2 to 4, decreasing 3 or less overnight into Monday, settling Northerly later.


##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight.


##Weather##

Mainly fair, but with a risk of mist patches.


##Visibility##

Moderate or good, occasionally poor in any mist.
